//: Import map and Deno settings for all four Edge Functions.
Supabase's docs prefer a deno.json per function directory, for dependency isolation.
One shared file is used here deliberately: the four functions are thin transport
wrappers over the same modules in api/ and src/lib/, so version-skewing them against
each other is not a feature -- it would mean the payment verifier and the order creator
could disagree about which supabase-js they run. Revisit if a function ever gains a
dependency the others do not have.
The @vercel/node entry is type-only: api/*.ts do `import type { VercelRequest,
VercelResponse }` from that specifier. The import is erased at runtime, but deno check
still has to resolve it, so it is mapped to local structural types rather than the real
package -- which would drag a second @types/node into the graph. See
_shared/vercel-types.ts.
compilerOptions mirror the strictness the root tsconfig.json applies to src/ and api/,
so deno check and `npm run typecheck` agree rather than each passing what the other
rejects. no-explicit-any is excluded from lint to match eslint: the handlers carry
deliberate `any`s at the Supabase and Razorpay payload boundaries, already accepted as
warnings in `npm run lint`, and failing a deploy over them would block on a style choice
that was reviewed and kept.
Formatting here is prettier's job, via eslint, exactly as for src/ and tests/. Do not
run `deno fmt` on this directory: the two disagree on line breaks, so each would report
the other's output as wrong and `npm run lint` would never be clean. `deno lint` is
still useful and conflict-free -- it checks correctness, not layout.
Pass explicitly on deploy, since a non-default location is not auto-detected:
supabase functions deploy --import-map supabase/functions/deno.json
